newsitem.title: USA: BBN, TI venture wins govt contract.
newsitem.headline: BBN, TI venture wins govt contract.

text.p: BBN Corp and Texas Instruments Inc said on Wednesday its logistics joint venture received a $60 million five-year contract from the U.S. Department of Defense.

The Advanced Logistics Program Integration and Engineering joint venture was formed to support a U.S. government project to develop software tools that would improve military logistics, the companies said.
The venture recieved the contract, to be split equally between the companies, to create an information technology system to meet wartime and other military logistic needs.
The contract was awarded by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, the technology and research arm of the Department of Defense, BBN said.
